# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price opens outside the opening range (OR) and then reverts to VWAP with a rejection candle within the first 30 minutes, it often fades back toward the mean due to mean-reversion pressure after an initial imbalance. This edge exists because OR breaches often represent temporary order flow imbalances that get corrected as liquidity providers step in, causing price to revert to the intraday average (VWAP). The strategy targets short entries on bearish engulfing candles after OR breach and VWAP reversion to capture this fade.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If the opening price is > OR_high (or < OR_low) and within the first 30 minutes price crosses VWAP and forms a bearish engulfing candle (close < open, body > prior candle's body) with volume > average volume of the last 20 bars, enter short at the close of that candle.  
**Exit:** Stop above the high of the opening range, target at VWAP (or 1R), optionally trail with an 8-bar chandelier.  
**Regime filter:** Only active when VIX > 18 and during the first hour after open (09:30-10:30 ET).

   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility crush after entry (e.g., FOMC news) causing rapid adverse move past OR_high stop.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L.
